title: Comparator rewind
statement: Let $w,u,v$ be Boolean words, let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $w$, let $b$ be a Boolean register value, and let $j\le\max(|u|,|v|)$. Starting in the comparator's rewind phase with both word-tape heads at displacement $j-1$ and register $b$, after $j+1$ steps it is in the return phase with both heads at displacement zero and the register still equal to $b$.
replaced:
From the comparator's rewind state with both heads at displacement $j-1$,
for any $j \le \max(\abs{u}, \abs{v})$, exactly $j+1$ steps restore both
heads to displacement $0$ and enter the return state, preserving the
comparison register.
